title: feat(console)!: record create and edit stop loading internal forms; a field's Show on create switch
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JpRoUZGqtwqMU5k7b4C58D)_

Fixes #36425

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #36455

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：控制台里新建、编辑记录的弹窗和整页，以及动作弹出的新建编辑窗口，一律按对象的字段分组排，不再按应用包里写的内部表单排；字段多了一个「新建时显示」开关，关掉的字段新建时不出现、编辑时仍在。
- 为什么做：运行界面设计模式专题，把表单设计收归到字段分组和字段规则上，不再维护两套。
- 出错会怎样：写了内部表单的对象（如 HotCRM 的 22 个）新建弹窗的分段名称和顺序会变、表单上的必填不再拦；对外表单不受影响；撤回本次合并即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**The four Console create / edit surfaces stop loading an internal form view.** The create dialog and the edit dialog (`AppContent`), the full-page create and edit (`RecordFormPage`, `/new` and `/record/:id/edit`) and a create or edit an action opens (`useActionModal`) no longer call `selectRecordFormView` (deleted). They lay the record out by the object's field groups and follow the rules on its fields (`visibleWhen`, `readonlyWhen`, `requiredWhen`, `required`). The field list for all three now comes from one helper, `recordFormFieldNames(fields, flow)` (`utils/recordFormFields.ts`). It drops fields the console never lists (`isObjectFieldListed`) and, on a create, every field with `showOnCreate: false` (`isFieldAskedOnFlow`).

**What an internal form used to steer and now steers nothing.** This covers the object's default form (`form`, `formViews.default`, an `isDefault` form ViewItem) and its `create` form view (`formViews.create`, `OBJECT.create`):
- `sections` (and their `columns`, `collapsible`, `visibleWhen`, field entries with `required` / `readonly` / `visibleWhen`);
- the `tabbed` and `wizard` layouts (`type`), with `defaultTab` and `tabPosition`;
- `subforms`. Master-detail sub-tables now come only from `fieldGroups[].relatedList`; the derived list is stored as `groupSubforms` and no longer merged into `obj.form`.
- `modalSize`. The dialog keeps its own derived size, and `'full'` when a sub-table is present.
- `buttons` (submit / cancel text and visibility);
- `layout`;
- `defaults` (create initial values).

**Nothing is removed from the definition side.** An app that still declares an internal form installs and runs; the definition is inert. A public form (`sharing.enabled === true`, the one test) keeps loading at `/forms/NAME` by its own definition. So does a named form a `form`-type action opens (apps/console `FormPage`, untouched).

**Flow screens.** `ScreenView` reads its sub-table settings from `fieldGroups[].relatedList` through `recordFormSubforms`, and no longer from `objectDef.form.subforms`.

**`showOnCreate` is live.** The ledger row is flipped to `live`, citing `isFieldAskedOnFlow`, `recordFormFieldNames` and its three callers. The field form row is added to `field.form.ts` with its 11 metadata-forms locale entries. The omit row in `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` is deleted. The Studio field inspector shows a "Show on create" checkbox in Advanced. It is on by default, and on is stored as no key. Off writes `showOnCreate: false`. For a required field it is locked on, with the reason shown.

**Lint.** A new advisory rule, `form-view-internal-not-loaded`, gives one warning (never an error) per internal create / edit form. It fires on a container's `form`, `formViews.create` and `formViews.default`, and on a form ViewItem that is `isDefault` or named `OBJECT.create`. It never fires on a public or a named form. The hint is the card's sentence. The rule is registered in `AUTHORING_RULES` (advisory, CLI-only) and `os explain` knows it.

**Upgrade guide.** A new protocol-18 semantic migration entry, `internal-record-forms-not-loaded`, tells an upgrader what moves where. There is no conversion: no stored row is rewritten. The changeset declares it as its ADR-0087 disposition (`registered`). Four docs CLI transcripts now print the author-time rule count as 76 (`check:docs-transcript-drift`). The field liveness count shard is regenerated.

**Studio.**
- The Data pillar's Form tab always lays out the object's field groups; the form-view designer path is removed (`useFormViewDraft.ts`, `formViewSections.ts`, the New/Edit picker and the form-view chip).
- The Interfaces rail no longer lists an internal form (`offNavViewIsInternalForm`, the same test as the lint rule). Public forms and named forms stay listed.

**Console-side readers of an object's form definition.** Measured by grep for `.form`, `formViews` and `selectRecordFormView` over `ui/packages/*/src` and `ui/apps/console/src`:

| Reader | After this PR |
|---|---|
| `AppContent` New / Edit dialog | field groups + field rules; no form view |
| `RecordFormPage` (`/new`, `/edit`) | same |
| `useActionModal` (action create / edit) | same |
| `ScreenView` (flow screen; fed by `FlowRunner` and `ScreenPreview`) | sub-tables from `fieldGroups[].relatedList` |
| `editFormLockedByState` (used by `RecordDetailView`, not edited here) | reads `groupSubforms` |
| `MetadataProvider.attachInlineSubforms` | writes `groupSubforms`; `form` stays merged but inert |
| Studio Data Form tab (`StudioDesignSurface`, `ObjectFormDesigner`) | field groups only |
| Studio Interfaces rail | hides internal forms |
| `ViewPreview` (named-form preview) | unchanged, named forms are in scope to keep |
| apps/console `FormPage` (`/forms/NAME`) | unchanged: public and named forms |
| plugin-view `ObjectView` `schema.form` | no console caller passes it; unchanged |

**HotCRM create defaults a field `defaultValue` does not cover: NOT MEASURED.** This session cannot read objectstack-ai/hotcrm (GitHub answered 403, access not enabled). The card's own counts are 22 internal forms, 29 form-level `required`, and 6 showcase forms in the lead file. Each form's `defaults` block is what a field `defaultValue` must replace. A default that depends on the opening context (parent record, current user, URL) is the case a static `defaultValue` cannot express. HotCRM is not migrated here, per the card.

## Tests

New:
- `console/__tests__/AppContent.internalFormRetired-36425.test.tsx` (renamed from `AppContent.formViewChrome-26843`):
  - a create and an edit carry no form `sections` / tabs / `modalSize` / `subforms`;
  - `showOnCreate: false` is absent on create and present on edit;
  - the real dialog shows the field groups;
  - CONTROL: an object without a form gets the same dialog.
- `views/RecordFormPage.internalFormRetired-36425.test.tsx` (renamed from `RecordFormPage.formViewChrome-26843`): the same contract on `/new` and `/edit`, plus sub-tables from `groupSubforms`.
- `hooks/__tests__/useActionModal.internalFormRetired-36425.test.tsx`: an action create / edit through the real `ModalForm`.
- `views/studio-design/DataPillar.internalFormRetired-36425.test.tsx` (replaces `DataPillar.formViewLayout-30057`): an object with an internal form gets the field-groups canvas, and Add group saves `fieldGroups`; Preview shows the field groups; CONTROL: no form view.
- `views/studio-design/InterfacesNavRail.internalFormHidden-36425.test.ts`: default and create forms are hidden; public and named forms are listed; sharing off counts as internal.
- `views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.showOnCreate-36425.test.tsx`: on by default; off writes `false`; on removes the key; locked for a required field.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-internal-form-views.test.ts`: fires on `form` / `formViews.create` / `formViews.default` / `isDefault` / `OBJECT.create`; CONTROLS for public and named forms; registered and explainable.

Public forms still render by their own definition. The `/forms/NAME` route tests are re-run unchanged: `FormPage.sectionGroup`, `FormPage.tabbedLayout-26843`, `FormPage.formViewChrome-26843`, `FormPage.wizardSteps-27224`, `FormPage.visibleWhen`, `FormPage.publicHeading`.

Updated, because they asserted form-driven layout:
- `utils/__tests__/recordFormNavigation.test.ts`: the `resolveFormViewLayout` block is replaced by `recordFormSubforms`, `isFieldAskedOnFlow` and `resolveRecordFormModalLayout`.
- `utils/__tests__/formViewChrome-26843.test.ts`: the tab-keys block is removed, and a `resolveRecordFormChrome` block is added.
- `providers/MetadataProvider.merge.test.ts`: `groupSubforms` replaces the merged `form.subforms`, and the explicit-override case is inverted.
- `providers/__tests__/MetadataProvider.composedObjectsIdentity-11699.test.tsx`
- `utils/editFormLockedByState.test.ts`
- `views/metadata-admin/previews/ScreenPreview.test.tsx`: sub-tables come from `groupSubforms`; CONTROL: the internal form's subforms are not forwarded.
- `console/__tests__/openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts`: the Studio row's reason.

Deleted, because each pinned only the retired behaviour:
- `AppContent.formViewModalSize-12803`
- `createModalHonorsFormView`
- `createFormView-13099`
- `recordFormModalSize-12803`
- `RecordFormPage.createFormView-13099`
- `formViewSections-30057`

The #30057 / #30859 / #32610 cases in `DataPillar.formViewLayout-30057` pinned the form-view designer, which is retired.

## Acceptance notes

- Flow screen object forms are not filtered by `showOnCreate`. The card names three create surfaces (dialog, full page, action), and a flow screen is not one of them.
- `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` `form.modalSize`: the only Console reader it named (the record dialog through `resolveFormViewLayout`) is gone. A named or public form opens on a full page, not a dialog. The note now says so and that a re-audit is owed; the status is not flipped here.
- Stale comments still name the deleted `resolveFormViewLayout`; they are history notes, not readers, and are left alone:
  - `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx:60`
  - `FormPage.visibleWhen.test.tsx:12`
  - plugin-form `sectionVisibleWhen-6111`, `sectionStyleKeysRetired-13626` and `modalFormSectionGroupReference-11542`
  - `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` and `studio-authoring.json`. These describe the retired default-form overlay recipe and need a checklist re-audit. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` is OK (0 anchors lost).
- `examples/**` and HotCRM still declare internal forms; they now draw the lint warning. Neither is migrated here, per the card.
- Changed lines: +1415 / −2596 across 66 files, over the 3000-line human-merge threshold. Most of the size is deleted tests and the deleted Studio form-view designer.

## Verification

Local readings, final head `90161b5f6`. Tests and builds ran through the shared verify lock; gate families ran outside it. The last commit only changes four docs transcripts (75 to 76 rules); the test runs below were at `407dbcf41`.

<details><summary>Tests (all green)</summary>

- app-shell, 18 files by path (the new and updated pins above, plus `ObjectFieldInspector.test`, `packageSurfaces.test`, `InterfacesNavRail.editKinds-34796`, `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesNavTree-12455` and `openPathObjectReaders-12811`): Test Files 18 passed, Tests 254 passed.
- console `/forms/NAME` pins, 6 files: Test Files 6 passed, Tests 61 passed.
- `@objectstack/lint`, whole package: Test Files 226 passed, Tests 9446 passed.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects`, whole package: Test Files 125 passed, Tests 2126 passed. The metadata-form catalog count pin is updated from 756 to 757 for the new row.
- `@object-ui/i18n`, whole package: Test Files 106 passed, Tests 1978 passed, 13 skipped.
- spec, by path: `field-show-on-create`, `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation`, `migrations`, `semantic-relevance`, `spec-changes-surface-scope`. Test Files 5 passed, Tests 269 passed.
- cli `migrate-meta-engine-guidance`: passed.
- dogfood, by path only: `view-container-default-form`, `public-form-submit-answer`. Test Files 2 passed, Tests 5 passed. The rest of the dogfood battery is NOT MEASURED; the dispatch order says to run files by path.
- Typecheck, each exit 0: lint `typecheck`, spec `typecheck`, platform-objects `typecheck`, i18n `type-check`, and app-shell `type-check` (the latter after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one reader)</summary>

`isFieldAskedOnFlow` was mutated to always answer true, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `bdfd87eb5c24` to `41b0344171d5`. This went red in the 4 create-time `showOnCreate` cases: AppContent "a create leaves out a showOnCreate: false field", RecordFormPage "a create leaves out ... an edit lists it", useActionModal "a create leaves out a showOnCreate: false field", and recordFormNavigation `isFieldAskedOnFlow`. The run had 2 more red cases that were already red before the mutation; both were fixed in a later commit. The file was restored with blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. No build was needed: app-shell tests import the source directly.

</details>

<details><summary>Gate families</summary>

`dispatch-gates --ran`: 125 derived families accounted for; 124 ran with exit 0. 1 is NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 because it needs every package's dist, so CI runs it. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` is OK, with 0 anchors lost. `check-nul-bytes` exits 0.

</details>

**Files to read first:**
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts`: the retired selection, `isFieldAskedOnFlow` and `resolveRecordFormModalLayout`.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`: the dialog's schema hunk.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`: `attachInlineSubforms` now writes `groupSubforms`.

**Two-minute check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.internalFormRetired-36425.test.tsx`. Expect all cases green. The create's field list is `subject, status, account`; the edit's adds `internal_note`.
